notes: TDF official release (2025-09-18) confirms opening of its 5th data center at Pic Rouge, on the heights of Papeete (300m altitude, outside flood zone): delivered June 2025 after H1 2025 works, repurposed former TV/radio/broadcast building, heat-recovery cooling, rooftop photovoltaics planned by end 2025, fibre + HD microwave connectivity, passed Tier III level compliance audit by a certified body (energy, cooling, fire detection/extinction, perimeter security). First customers on opening: Banque de Polynesie (Societe Generale subsidiary) and Axians Polynesie. Baxtel lists ~0.3 MW (C-grade directory figure, not used as official capacity).
